Testing of coupons: Short beam shear testing was performed following ASTM D2344/D2344M-22 using Wyoming Test Fixture WTF- SB-422 flex fixture. The fixture was adjusted for a singe 0.25” diameter load pin, and two 0.125 in. diameter support pins. The span settings were calculated at 4x the average thickness for each material. Tensile test specimens were prepared in accordance with ASTM D3039/D3039M-17, with dimensions of 1 inch in width and 10 inches in length. Machining was carried out using an Extec Labcut 5000 precision 2-axis CNC diamond wet saw. G10 fiberglass tabs were bonded using the EA-9394 C2 epoxy adhesive system to facilitate load introduction and reduce grip slippage; tab surfaces were lightly sanded to further enhance grip. Manually operated grips were used for testing. The wedges were knurled to decrease slipping of the specimen. A single face mounted Epsilon model 3542 clip on extensometer was used to record strain during testing. Tests were controlled using a constant crosshead displacement rate of 0.05 in/min. All specimens were preconditioned for at least 24 hours at laboratory ambient conditions prior to testing. All specimens were visually inspected, and dimensions measured prior to being loaded into the test frame. Room temperature tests were conducted under ambient lab conditions, while cryogenic tests were performed with specimens fully submerged in liquid nitrogen. 8.6.
